meta.title: Per-province average monthly household income — NSO SES 2566, AUTHORITATIVE
meta.label: MEASURED — average monthly household income (THB) per canonical Thai province, all households, from the National Statistical Office Socio-Economic Survey (SES) 2566 (2023 CE), pulled from NSO's own open-data catalog and reconstructed to the province level by household-weighted mean over the survey's socioeconomic strata.
meta.source: NSO (สำนักงานสถิติแห่งชาติ), กองสถิติสังคม — CKAN package 0705_08_0007, resource SFD_SPB0802_66 (b0817d48-5eec-4ed9-a677-639d304d20ec). Household weights from the debt table SFD_SPB0806.
meta.basis: ALL households; leaf total monthly income (source_income 'รายได้ทั้งสิ้นต่อเดือน'), household-weighted to the province level.
meta.method: Province average = household-weighted mean of each socioeconomic leaf group's (soc_eco_class1 x soc_eco_class2) total monthly income, weighted by that leaf's total-household count from the debt table (SFD_SPB0806). The income table carries no household-count column and no pre-aggregated 'all households' row, so the province total is reconstructed from the strata.
meta.national_check: Equals NSO's published SES 2566 national headline (29030 THB/month) — the reconstruction's built-in correctness proof.
meta.gate: network puller, NOT in the determinism gate (live off-repo input, like pull_nso_ses_debt.py). Everything downstream of this committed file IS gated: build_household_risk.py --check.
